title: Google Analytics
text: This portfolio is live-instrumented with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) — not just as a tracking tool, but as a demonstration of real production analytics skills. Every pageview, recruiter interaction, and conversion is measured and attributed.

title: Google Analytics
text:
GA4 property setup
The GA4 tracking snippet is embedded in Quarto’s _quarto.yml using the built-in Google Analytics integration:
# In _quarto.yml
website:
  google-analytics:
    tracking-id: "G-9H4032DBJD"
    anonymize-ip: true
This automatically injects the gtag.js script across all pages with no additional configuration.

title: Google Analytics
text:
Custom events being tracked
Beyond pageviews, the following custom events are configured to track meaningful recruiter actions:








Event name
Trigger
Purpose




resume_download
Click on resume PDF link
Measure recruiter interest


project_view
Click into a project case study
Identify most-read content


contact_click
Click on email or LinkedIn
Track outreach intent


presentation_viewed
Load of presentation.qmd
Measure technical content reach



Custom events are added via inline JavaScript on relevant elements using gtag('event', 'event_name', {parameters}) attached to the onclick attribute of the relevant anchor or button element.

title: Google Analytics
text:
Conversion goals
Two primary conversions are configured in GA4:

Resume download — A recruiter downloaded the resume (strongest intent signal)
Contact click — A recruiter clicked the LinkedIn or email link

These are marked as Key Events in the GA4 interface, allowing funnel analysis from page entry → project view → contact action.

title: Google Analytics
text:
SEO instrumentation
In addition to behavioral analytics, the site is optimized for search visibility:

Page-level metadata — each .qmd file includes a description field rendered as <meta name="description">.
Open Graph tags — Quarto’s og: fields are set for social sharing previews.
Canonical URLs — the site-url in _quarto.yml ensures consistent canonical links.
Sitemap — Quarto auto-generates sitemap.xml, submitted to Google Search Console.

title: Google Analytics
text:
Viewing the data
Live data is available in the GA4 property dashboard under the property G-PSW1MY7HB4. Key reports used:

Engagement → Events — to monitor custom event counts
Acquisition → Traffic acquisition — to see referral vs. direct vs. search
Explore → Funnel exploration — to analyze the recruiter journey from landing → project view → contact

title: Google Analytics
text:
Privacy considerations

anonymize-ip: true is set so no full IP addresses are stored.
A cookie consent notice is not currently displayed, as this is a personal portfolio with no commercial data collection.
No personally identifiable information (PII) is sent to GA4.

title: Google Analytics
text:
SEO configuration
The site is optimized for search engine discoverability using the following techniques.

Meta tags
Every page includes Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags configured via _quarto.yml:
website:
  open-graph: true
  twitter-card: true
  title: "Austin Voth | Marketing Analytics"
  description: "Portfolio of Austin Voth — Marketing Analytics professional skilled in R, Excel, and Google Analytics."


Sitemap
Quarto automatically generates a sitemap.xml at build time. This is submitted to Google Search Console to accelerate crawl indexing.


Semantic HTML
All pages use proper heading hierarchy (h1 → h2 → h3) and descriptive title and description front-matter fields so search engines understand page content.

title: Google Analytics
text:
Google Search Console integration
The portfolio is connected to Google Search Console to monitor:

Keyword impressions and click-through rate
Page indexing status
Core Web Vitals scores
Mobile usability issues

title: Google Analytics
text:
Looker Studio live report
A public-facing Looker Studio report is connected to this site’s GA4 property, displaying real-time traffic, engagement, and conversion metrics. This demonstrates end-to-end analytics fluency — from instrumentation to reporting.







Tip



To connect your own GA4: Replace G-XXXXXXXXXX in _quarto.yml with your Measurement ID from analytics.google.com, then rebuild and redeploy the site.
